newsitem.title: USA: Ferrofluidics to cut jobs, post charge.
newsitem.headline: Ferrofluidics to cut jobs, post charge.

text.p: Ferrofluidics Corp said on Thursday that it is reducing its U.S. workforce by 15 percent over the next three months -- a move that will result in a $100,000 fourth quarter charge and $1.5 million in anticipated savings.
Also, Ferrofluidics said it expects revenues of $17 million for the company's third quarter ended March 29, which is lower than the $19.8 million reported in last year's third quarter.
Ferrofluidics said the lower third quarter revenues came from delays in shipments of two puller systems that had been scheduled for delivery in March.
Revenues for the fiscal year are likely to be slightly below last year's revenues, Ferrofluidics said.
Ferrofluidics plans to cut about 37 full-time positions in its U.S. operations over the next three months, a company spokesman said.
